urls.description: Flat bands harbor exotic electron physics. A new way of realizing them could make the physics more accessible.

urls.description: In the Research Article “Divergent evolution of nitrogen cycling along gradients of landscape water velocities” by S. Wu et al. (11 June 2026, 10.1126/science.aed0399), errors in table S4 and Fig. 2H have been corrected. In table S4, the statistics for the entire Danube basin were mistakenly reported for each of the three Danube subbasins, and the line plot from Fig. 2I was mistakenly duplicated in Fig. 2H. These errors have been corrected and did not affect any analyses, interpretations, or conclusions presented in the paper. Furthermore, the source code and modeling workflow have been made available on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21478187); to account for this, a new reference has been added, and the new code has been disclosed in the acknowledgments.
urls.title: Erratum for the Research Article “Divergent evolution of nitrogen cycling along gradients of landscape water velocities”
